questions.question: Shubham borrowed certain amount from bank at rate of 15% per annum simple interest for 3 years. If he fails to pay debt after 3 years, then rate of interest is increased to 20% and Shubham pay his debt at the end of 5 years and paid Rs. 4800 extra, then what is the amount borrowed by Shubham?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Original rate = 15% and time = 3 years

**FORMULA USED:**

SI = PRT/100

P = Principal, T = Time, R = Rate

**CALCULATION:**

Let amount borrowed by Shubham be ‘x’.

Amount of interest after 3 years = (x × 15 × 3)/100 = 0.45x

Amount of interest after 5 years = [(x × 15 × 3) + (x × 20 × 2)]/100 = 0.85x

According to the question:

0.85x – 0.45x = 4800

⇒ 0.4x = 4800

⇒ x = 12000

∴, amount borrowed by Shubham = x = Rs. 12000

questions.question: The population of Varanasi is 2,25,000. If the annual birth rate and death rate are 9 % and 7 %, calculate the population of city after 2 years.
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

Total population = 225000

annual birth rate = 9%

annual death rate = 7%

**Concept used:**

We will first calculate the net percentage change in a year when the annual birth rate is 9% and the annual death rate is 7%. Next, calculate the population increase in one year and find the population after one year. Then, find the population increase after the first year and add it to the population of the first year to find the population after the second year.

**Calculation:**

according to problem 

Net increased per year = (9 – 7)%

⇒ 2%

So after 1 year, the increase will be = 225000 × (102/100)

⇒ 229500

After 1 more year, the increase will be = 229500 × (102/100)

⇒ 234090

**∴ the population of the city after 2 years is 234090**

questions.question: The average of 12 numbers is 40. The average of the first seven numbers is 30 then finds the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Overall average of 12 numbers = 40

Deviation of first 7 numbers from average = 30 − 40 = −10

Total deviation to be balanced = 7 × (−10) = −70

Deviation for remaining 5 numbers = +70

Average of remaining numbers = 40 + (70 ÷ 5) = 40 + 14 = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Average of 12 numbers = 40

Average of first 7 numbers = 30

Number of remaining numbers = 12 − 7 = 5

Formula used: Sum = Average × Count

 
 
• 
 Total: 12 Numbers (Average = 40)
 First 7 Numbers
 Average = 30
 Remaining 5
 Average = ?
 

 Total Sum = 12 × 40 = 480

Calculations:

⇒ Total sum of 12 numbers = 12 × 40 = 480

⇒ Sum of first 7 numbers = 7 × 30 = 210

⇒ Sum of remaining 5 numbers = 480 − 210 = 270

⇒ Average of remaining 5 numbers = 270 ÷ 5 = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the combined average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Effect of Operations on Average

If every number in a data set is increased or decreased by a constant k, the average of the set also increases or decreases by k.</p

questions.question: Three persons A, B and C start at the same time in the same direction to run around a circular playground. A completes a round in 75 seconds, B in 175 seconds and C in 130 seconds, all starting from the same point. After what time (in minutes) will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A, B and C are running around a circular playground.

Time taken by A to complete a round = 75 seconds.

Time taken by B to complete a round = 175 seconds.

Time taken by C to complete a round = 130 seconds.

**Concept used:**

When running around a circular track, the time of meeting of the runners is determined by the LCM of their individual times.

**Calculation:**

We find LCM of 75, 175 and 130 by prime factorization as:

75 = 3¹ **× 5²**

**175 = 5² × 7¹**

**130 = 2¹ × 5¹ × 13¹**

**Thus,**

**LCM = 2 × 3 × 5 × 5 × 7 × 13 = 13650 seconds.**

We convert this time into minutes as

13650 / 60 

= 227(1)/(2)** minutes.**

**∴ ****They will meet again at the starting point after 227 (1)/(2) ** **minutes.**

questions.question: Rohan borrows Rs. 6,000 from Mohit at 3% per annum on simple interest. He pays Rs. 240 as interest, when will he pay the debt?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

P = Rs. 6,000, R = 3%, SI = Rs. 240, T = ?

**FORMULAE USED:**

SI = PRT/100

**CALCULATION:**

⇒ 240 = 6000 × T × 3%

⇒ 240 = 180T

⇒ T = 4/3 years

⇒ T = (4/3) × 12 months

⇒ T = 16 months

∴ Rohan will pay the debt after 16 months.

questions.question: A person buys 10 items for Rs. 8 and sells them at the rate of Rs. 1.25 per item. His percentage profit is-
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Cost price of 10 items = Rs. 8

Selling price of 1 item = Rs. 1.25

**Formula: **

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation: **

Cost price of 10 items = Rs. 8

Selling price of 10 items = 1.25 × 10 = Rs. 12.5

Profit = 12.5 – 8 = 4.5

∴ Profit % = 4.5/8 × 100 = 56(1)/(4)\%

questions.question: A right circular cylinder has height 63 cm and radius 28 cm, two hemisphere of radius 14 cm each are cut from each of the two bases of cylinder. What is the total surface area of the remaining solid?
questions.solution:
Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × 28 × 63 = 44 × 4 × 63 = 11088 cm²

⇒ Curved surface area of 4 hemispheres = 4(2 × π × 14 × 14) = 4928 cm²

⇒ For the two bases of the cylinder, remaining area = 2 × (π × 28²) – 4 × (π × 14²)

⇒ Remaining base area = 44 × 112 – 44 × 56 = 44 × 56 = 2464 cm²

⇒ Total surface area of the remaining solid = (11088 + 4928 + 2464) cm²

⇒ Total surface area of the remaining solid = 18480 cm²

questions.question: An amount is divided among three persons in ratio 4 : 9 : 2. If second person gets Rs. 1200 more than that of the first person then what is the amount received by the third person?
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

The amount divided among the three persons are in the ratio = 4 : 9 : 2

**Concept:**

If N is divided into a : b, then

First part = N × a/(a + b)

Second part = N × b/(a + b)

**Calculation:**

Share of the first person, the second person and the third person = 4x : 9x : 2x

According to the question

9x – 4x = 1200

⇒ 5x = 1200

⇒ x = 1200/5

⇒ x = 240

∴ Share of the third person = 2 × 240 = Rs. 480

questions.question: What will be the HCF of 7/9, 14/185 and 7/10?
questions.solution:
**Given**

7/9, 14/185, 7/10

**Concept used**

HCF of fraction = (HCF of numerator) / (LCM of denominator)

**Calculation**

HCF of 7, 14, 7 = 7

Prime factors of 9 = 3 × 3

Prime factors of 185 = 5 × 37

Prime factors of 10 = 2 × 5 

So, LCM of 9, 185, 10 = 3330

HCF of fraction = 7/3330

questions.question: The policeman saw a thief from a distance of 80 m. When the policeman starts the chase, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the thief be 10 km/h and that of the policeman 12 km/h, how far will the thief have run before he is overtaken?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 80 m = 0.08 km

Thief's speed = 10 km/h

Policeman's speed = 12 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

Relative speed = 12 - 10 = 2 km/h

Time to catch thief = 0.08 / 2 = 0.04 hours

Thief's distance = 10 × 0.04 = 0.4 km

Thief's distance = 0.4 × 1000 = 400 m

**∴ The thief will have run 400 m.**

questions.question: When the price of an item was reduced by 25% then its sale was increased by x%. If there is an increase of 20% in the receipt of the revenue, then the value of x will be∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Revenue = Price × Sale

Price Ratio = 100 : 75 = 4 : 3

Revenue Ratio = 100 : 120 = 5 : 6

Sale Ratio = (Revenue Ratio ÷ Price Ratio) = (5/4) : (6/3) = 1.25 : 2

Percentage increase in sale (x) = [(2 − 1.25) ÷ 1.25] × 100 = (0.75 ÷ 1.25) × 100 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Price reduction = 25%, Revenue increase = 20%, Sale increase = x%.

Formula: Revenue = Price × Sale

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36ec4c79af229f74a01529e6efb20b1970b9d19ffb43e3d1793adc2aa6097934.png] 

Let initial Price = 100 and initial Sale = 100.

⇒ Initial Revenue = 100 × 100 = 10000

⇒ New Price = 100 − 25% of 100 = 75

⇒ New Revenue = 10000 + 20% of 10000 = 12000

⇒ New Sale = New Revenue ÷ New Price

⇒ New Sale = 12000 ÷ 75 = 160

⇒ Increase in Sale = New Sale − Initial Sale = 160 − 100 = 60

⇒ Percentage increase (x) = (60 ÷ 100) × 100 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

**__Additional Information__**

Net Percentage Change Formula

If two variables change by a% and b%, the net effect on their product is (a + b + ab/100)%. Here, −25 + x + (−25x/100) = 20.

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed by x% and then y%, the final value is Initial × (1 + x/100) × (1 + y/100).

Fractional Conversions

25% = 1/4 (Reduction factor = 3/4) and 20% = 1/5 (Increase factor = 6/5). Multiplying factor for sale = (6/5) ÷ (3/4) = 8/5 = 1.6.</p

Time taken = Distance / speed
